provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Vuelmora is centered at -17.702744, 108.949704 under Cooperative Commonwealth, with 82,389,000 people across 8 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Vuelmora occupies 6,814,295.07 sq mi / 17,648,943.22 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.460130% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Grassland and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming and Partial forest. Population density is 4.668 people/sq km / 12.091 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Glasswell Institute, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Setrimir, Raeshkul, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 9 recorded four-province geography group links, including 8 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Sheff of the Empty Cup
npcs.description:
Sheff of the Empty Cup is a shaky but sweet-natured Sea Elf drifter trying to rebuild their life after years of dependence on cheap diluted ichor tonics nearly ruined them. Their fixation has shifted onto Kelp-Kola, a fizzy caffeinated drink made from kelp, sugar, mineral salts, and coastal herbs, which they treat like a miracle cure, comfort object, and personal religion all at once. Sea elves in Belavadös are ocean-adapted people tied to reef culture, aquatic survival, and seafaring communities, which fits Sheff’s water-hauling work and nervous familiarity with canals, cisterns, and shoreline errands.
At the Thyravéa-Morn Guild Desk, Sheff runs water errands, carries messages, helps stock boarding houses, and rambles endlessly about Kelp-Kola flavors, bottle shapes, carbonation strength, and “proper drinking temperature.” They are awkward, lonely, overly grateful for small kindnesses, and more perceptive than people assume; the Freeblade Veil keep them close because a reliable bed, honest work, and one cold bottle can sometimes save a life better than any sermon. Thyravéa-Morn is one of Vuelmora’s towns, and Vuelmora is treated as a plains province with deep-cavern and subterranean settlement layers, giving Sheff plenty of uneasy routes, water stores, and settlement errands to navigate.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Thyravéa-Morn is a Town in Vuelmora, under Cooperative Commonwealth, with low danger, Farming, Partial forest, Grassland terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Sea Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Sea Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
